Back To Openings Traveling Construction Laborer Department Construction Services Location Dallas, TX START YOUR APPLICATION Summary The Traveling Construction Laborer is an entry-level craft professional responsible for supporting interior construction activities on tenant improvement, renovation, retail refresh, and light industrial projects throughout the United States. This is a travel-intensive role requiring deployment to project locations nationwide in support of Sevans self-perform operations. Working under the direction of a Foreman and/or Superintendent, this role performs selective demolition, material handling, site logistics, jobsite cleanup, and general labor activities while supporting multiple trades throughout all phases of construction. Travel Requirements Extensive nationwide travel is required. Employees should expect to travel to project locations for extended periods based on business needs. Company-paid lodging, travel accommodations, and applicable per diem are provided in accordance with company policy. Essential Duties and Responsibilities Perform selective demolition and removal of existing building materials and finishes. Clean and prepare work areas for construction activities. Load, unload, transport, stage, and organize materials, tools, and equipment. Assist carpenters, finish technicians, and other craft professionals with construction activities as directed. Assist with flooring preparation, drywall installation, framing, ceilings, finishes, punch list, and closeout activities under the direction of field leadership. Erect, move, and dismantle ladders, scaffolding, fencing, and other temporary jobsite equipment as required. Remove and properly dispose of debris, waste materials, and construction scrap. Maintain clean, organized, and safe work areas throughout the project lifecycle. Follow company safety procedures, PPE requirements, and all applicable regulations. Support project mobilization and demobilization activities. Operate hand tools, power tools, and basic construction equipment safely and effectively. Execute assigned work activities under the direction of the Foreman and coordinate effectively with project team members. Travel to project locations as required. Participate in safety meetings, training, and company development programs. Other duties as assigned. Qualifications High School Diploma or GED preferred. Previous construction, labor, warehouse, moving, manufacturing, logistics, or related experience preferred. Experience safely using hand tools, power tools, and basic construction equipment preferred. Ability to follow verbal and written instructions in a fast-paced construction environment. Valid drivers license preferred. OSHA 10 certification required or ability to obtain OSHA 30 preferred. Ability and willingness to travel extensively throughout the United States. Why Join Sevan Company-paid travel Company-paid lodging Per diem while traveling Opportunity for overtime Advancement into Foreman and Superintendent roles Year-round nationwide work High-quality tools and equipment Training and career development Sevan Multi-Site Solutions is a veteran-owned business that provides construction, program management, real estate site development, and architecture engineering services for restaurant, grocery, fuel and convenience store, retail, and government sectors nationwide. We work with leading brands like McDonalds, Starbucks, Sprouts, and BP, to name a few. At Sevan, we provide the talent, technology, and trusted expertise needed to consistently deliver excellence in multi-site construction. Sevan is nationally recognized for workplace culture, industry leadership, and safety. Recent honors include 12 consecutive years as a Great Place to Work, placement on ENRs national Program and Construction Management rankings, recognition as one of Americas Safest Companies for 2025, and the 2025 Platinum HIRE Vets Medallion Award. Pay Benefits Pay range 18- 26 per hour. Actual pay depends on education, experience, and performance. Benefits include dental, vision, paid holidays, sick time. Work Conditions This is a travel-intensive, field-based role supporting projects nationwide. Extensive travel to work on-site at active construction locations for extended periods based on project needs. Must have ability to stoop, stand, climb, frequently lift a minimum of 50 lbs. Regularly required to crouch and reach to install/move equipment by bending forward at the waist or by bending legs and spine. Involves movement between floors, and properties to facilitate work. Ability to speak clearly so others can understand you. Sevan Multi-Site Solutions, Inc. is proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, marital status, genetics, disability, pregnancy, veteran status or any other basis protected by law.
